title: Non-catalytic and catalytic TREHALOSE-6-PHOSPHATE SYNTHASES interact with RAMOSA3 to control maize development
authors: Tran TM; Claeys H; Abraham-Juárez MJ; Vi SL; Xu X; Michalski K; Chou TH; Iohannes SD; Boumpas P; Williams ZP; Sheppard S; Griffiths C; Paul MJ; Furukawa H; Jackson D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究玉米中非催化与催化海藻糖-6-磷酸合成酶与磷酸酶互作调控发育，属植物代谢与发育生物学，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Trehalose-6-phosphate (Tre6P) is the intermediate in the two-step pathway of trehalose biosynthesis mediated by Tre6P-synthases (TPSs) and Tre6P-phosphatases (TPPs). Plants harbor small families of TPS and TPP genes, however most plant TPSs lack enzymatic activity, suggesting they have regulatory functions. The classical mutant ramosa3 ( ra3 ) increases inflorescence branching in maize, and RA3 encodes a catalytic TPP. We found that RA3 interacts with maize ZmTPS1, a non-catalytic TPS. Mutants in Zm TPS1 and its close paralog Zm TPS12 enhance ra3 phenotypes, suggesting their physical interaction is biologically significant. ZmTPS1 also interacts with the two catalytically active maize TPSs, ZmTPS11 and ZmTPS14, however zmtps11;zmtps14 double mutants fail to complete embryogenesis, suggesting that they are essential, as in arabidopsis. Interestingly, the non-catalytic ZmTPS1 protein stimulated the coupled activity of RA3 and ZmTPS14, suggesting that RA3, ZmTPS1, and ZmTPS14 form a complex, and we confirmed this by expressing and purifying the three proteins and by Alphafold predictions. Our results suggest that non-catalytic TPSs form a complex with catalytic TPSs and TPPs to stimulate catalytic activity and regulate plant development.
abstract_zh: 海藻糖-6-磷酸（Tre6P）是海藻糖生物合成两步途径中的中间产物，该途径由Tre6P合酶（TPSs）和Tre6P磷酸酶（TPPs）介导。植物拥有小家族的TPS和TPP基因，然而大多数植物TPS缺乏酶活性，表明它们具有调控功能。经典突变体ramosa3（ra3）增加玉米花序分枝，RA3编码一种催化性TPP。我们发现RA3与玉米ZmTPS1（一种非催化性TPS）相互作用。ZmTPS1及其近缘旁系同源物ZmTPS12的突变增强了ra3的表型，表明它们的物理相互作用具有生物学意义。ZmTPS1还与两种具有催化活性的玉米TPS，即ZmTPS11和ZmTPS14相互作用，然而zmtps11;zmtps14双突变体无法完成胚胎发生，表明它们像在拟南芥中一样是必需的。有趣的是，非催化性ZmTPS1蛋白刺激了RA3和ZmTPS14的偶联活性，表明RA3、ZmTPS1和ZmTPS14形成复合物，我们通过表达和纯化这三种蛋白以及Alphafold预测证实了这一点。我们的结果表明，非催化性TPS与催化性TPS和TPP形成复合物，以刺激催化活性并调控植物发育。
